Definition: from the base of G1325; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift:--gift, giving.
BiblicalUsage: A giving, as James speaks of the giving from above, and Paul thanks the Philippians because no church shared with him in the matter of giving and receiving except them alone.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that giving is a two-way street in the gospel: God gives from above, and His people give to one another below.
